history.overview: The War Gate is the Muramite Legion’s strongest defensive position, guarding the entrance to the Proving Grounds.

timeline.name: Gate Constructed
timeline.description: Muramite engineers built the massive gate complex.

timeline.name: Elite Defenders Assigned
timeline.description: Warmasters and champions were stationed to guard the gate.

timeline.name: Discord Saturation
timeline.description: Discord energy warped the gate’s architecture and destabilized pylons.

timeline.name: Proving Grounds Activation
timeline.description: The gate became the primary entrance to the Muramite Proving Grounds.
